summary.prose: Building this Story means writing one new, injectable-seam module (src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts, split across two Tasks: construction/validation/refusal paths, then turn-execution internals), then mechanically re-pointing every existing backend and plugin import of the old app-server transport onto it, rewiring the backend's three vibe call sites to build adapter requests instead of constructing CLI argv directly, deleting the old transport module and its tests outright, and closing with a durable contract test plus a full regression sweep. No chat-visible behavior changes anywhere in this Story; the migration is purely an internal re-plumbing with one new fail-closed refusal path (read-only mode) that stays closed until a later Story supplies its qualification.

tasks.title: Add vibe-adapter.ts core: sc1/sc2 types, createVibeAdapter factory, and startTurn's request validation/refusal paths
tasks.summary: New, purely additive module src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts. Exports the sc1/sc2 types verbatim (VibeAdapterContext, VibeNewSession/VibeResumedSession, VibeTurnRequest, VibeTurnEvent, VibeTurnResult+VibeExitEvidence, VibeMcpToolIdentity) and createVibeAdapter(context, deps?) with injectable spawn/fs/process-group/clock seams, refusing construction when context.cwd is empty or not a directory. startTurn() validates the request shape and runs every refusal/mapping path BEFORE any subprocess spawns: the read-only refusal (refuses outright until s2's qualification exists), the read-only+approval-setting refusal, the new-session selection-catalog check surface, and the ordinary-session approval mapping (default/manual/edit-auto/auto). The re-homed VibeTurnError class (same refusal-marker shape structured-output.ts relies on) is defined here. Turn execution internals (event production, process-group cleanup, exit-evidence readback, naming) are a separate Task (t2) and are stubbed/deferred here -- nothing imports this module yet.

tasks.title: Add vibe-adapter.ts turn execution: live event production, process-group cleanup, exit-evidence readback, and naming
tasks.summary: Completes src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts: startTurn's live JSONL event production for outputMode:'streaming' (session/status/assistant-text/tool-call/tool-result/error variants) and final-message mapping for text/json modes; the dual process-group policy with termination/descendant-exit-confirmation/temp-file cleanup on every exit path (adapter-owned and supervisor-owned); exit-evidence readback from --output-dir export.json (stopReason, outcome, effectiveSelection), treating a missing/malformed export as absent evidence rather than fabricated; VibeMcpNaming.fromStreamedName (general insrc MCP tool identity) and the VibeInsrcAnalysisToolId allowlist (restricted); and runVibeTurn(options), the adapter-owned turn entry whose signature totally maps the plugin's existing VibeTurnOptions onto context+request with no chat behavior change.

tasks.title: Rewire the backend's vibe call sites onto the adapter; delete runVibe/vibeArgs
tasks.summary: complete() builds a new-session VibeTurnRequest (no selection) and consumes startTurn, returning the final assistant text. completeStructuredVibe() builds a VibeTurnRequest and consumes startTurn, keeping its existing local two-attempt ajv validation loop and the schema note riding the prompt (the tool has no native schema flag). The interactive-tools/auto-approve path maps its auto-approve flag onto the request's approval input. readOnlySessionOnce() builds a mode:'read-only' request whose tool-name set comes from the adapter's sc2 VibeInsrcAnalysisToolId allowlist -- the adapter refuses it before dispatch (the s1 fail-closed state, matching today's READ_ONLY_SESSION_VIBE_TOOL_NAMES behavior one-for-one). runVibe() and vibeArgs() are deleted outright -- the provider stops constructing vibe argv or branching into the app-server transport.
